description: Read last-24-hour stored call counts by HTTP status and reason, measured duration through response headers (including upstream wait), per-app anomaly scores and 24-hour anomaly counts, idle apps (active apps whose key made no allowed call in the project's idle_days, default 14; a flag only, never a revoke), and separate current-month gateway usage: plan, used, allowed, plus upgrade URL and checkout path on Free at 80% or above. Only POST the checkout path when the admin asks to upgrade; reading metrics never starts checkout. Project admin only. Audit may be partial: invalid-key sampling and audit-off periods are disclosed. No upstream requests, quota use or policy changes; not a health certificate or performance guarantee. For individual calls use gate_audit.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_metrics
title: Read Gate operational metrics
